venues.name: Dishoom Shoreditch
venues.verdict: The gateway curry house — beloved by tourists and Londoners alike. Bombay street food done brilliantly in a gorgeous Irani café setting.
venues.whatToOrder: Black daal (24-hour slow-cooked), chicken ruby, bacon naan roll at breakfast, house chai. Keema pao is a sleeper hit.

venues.name: Tayyabs
venues.verdict: The East London institution. Chaotic, noisy, BYOB-friendly, and serving the most fiercely debated lamb chops in the city.
venues.whatToOrder: Dry meat (signature sizzling lamb), lamb chops, seekh kebabs, masala fish. BYOB — no corkage.

venues.name: Gymkhana
venues.verdict: London's finest Indian restaurant. The wild muntjac biryani under pastry is worth the splurge and the impossible reservation.
venues.whatToOrder: Wild muntjac biryani, tandoori masala lamb chops, kid goat methi keema. Tasting menu if budget allows.

venues.name: Needoo Grill
venues.verdict: Started by Tayyabs' former head chef. The Sunday special alone is worth crossing London for.
venues.whatToOrder: Karahi gosht, lamb nihari (slow-cooked overnight), Sunday special, seekh kebabs with naan.

venues.name: Lahore Kebab House
venues.verdict: The OG Whitechapel curry house. Open until 1 AM, no-frills, home to the single best karahi gosht in London.
venues.whatToOrder: Karahi gosht (get it dry), lamb chops, seekh kebabs, tarka daal with butter naan.

venues.name: Gunpowder
venues.verdict: Small-plates Indian done brilliantly. The spice-crusted lamb chops are the stuff of Spitalfields legend.
venues.whatToOrder: Spice-crusted lamb chops, old Delhi butter chicken, rasam broth, crispy okra. 4–5 dishes per couple.

venues.name: Hoppers Marylebone
venues.verdict: Sri Lankan hoppers you won't find done this well anywhere else in London. From the Gymkhana family.
venues.whatToOrder: Egg hopper with seeni sambol, bone marrow varuval, mutton kothu roti, lamb dosa.

venues.name: Darjeeling Express
venues.address: Top Floor, Kingly Ct, London W1B 5PW
venues.verdict: Chef Asma Khan's supper club turned permanent restaurant. The set-menu thali is a highlight reel of home-style cooking.
venues.whatToOrder: Dinner set-menu thali — rotates but always includes Bengali aloo bonde, lamb curry, seasonal specials.

venues.name: Brigadiers
venues.verdict: Indian BBQ meets British gentlemen's club. Pool tables, craft beer, and an absurdly good tandoori chicken.
venues.whatToOrder: Whole tandoori chicken, lamb seekh kebab, bacon naan with chilli jam, pork vindaloo.

venues.name: Kricket Soho
venues.verdict: Indian street food meets British seasonal produce. The samosa chaat is reason enough to visit.
venues.whatToOrder: Samosa chaat, Kerala fried chicken, Keralan fish curry, Kricket naan with bone marrow.

venues.name: Manthan
venues.verdict: A Mayfair newcomer earning rave reviews. The stone bass curry with tamarind is a showstopper.
venues.whatToOrder: Stone bass fish curry with tamarind, egg curry with fenugreek, lamb rogan josh, breads.

venues.name: BiBi
venues.verdict: The Infatuation's highest-rated Indian in London (9.5/10). Every tasting menu dish is a revelation.
venues.whatToOrder: The tasting menu — trust it. Lahori chicken and raw Orkney scallop are standouts. Counter seats are best.
